name: Mandarin Oriental Pudong, Shanghai
insider_take: This towering luxury haven offers front-row seats to Shanghai's most dramatic skyline transformation, where ancient meets ultra-modern in spectacular fashion.
whats_special: Perched on floors 30-54 of Shanghai IFC Tower, this sky-high sanctuary boasts some of Asia's most breathtaking panoramic views. The hotel's signature spa features traditional Chinese healing therapies with modern wellness techniques, while its Michelin-starred dining scene includes the renowned Yong Yi Ting, serving exceptional Cantonese cuisine 50 floors above the bustling streets.
pro_tip: Book a Huangpu River-facing room on higher floors for unobstructed views of the iconic Bund skyline - particularly magical during sunset and the nightly LED light shows.
dont_miss: The hotel's location puts you steps from Century Avenue's luxury shopping and just minutes from the Maglev train station. Take advantage of the direct underground connection to the subway system, and don't skip cocktails at the sophisticated Bar Rouge-adjacent lounges with their floor-to-ceiling windows showcasing Shanghai's glittering financial district.
pros: Prime Lujiazui financial district location with stunning Huangpu River views
Exceptional spa and wellness facilities with traditional Asian treatments
Multiple award-winning restaurants including Michelin-starred dining
Luxurious rooms and suites with contemporary design and premium amenities
cons: Located across river from historic Bund area
